kind.description: forfeiture: options not vested, given up when the holder leaves; expiry: options that lapse, at the grant's expiry or once a leaver's window to exercise closes.

number.description: The options it takes, a whole number above zero: at most what the grant leaves, and for a forfeiture at most what is not vested on its day.

on.description: The day the options are forfeited or lapse, on or after the grant date; from it they are back in the pool.
